## About
Pro American Collision Center is an auto body shop on Pascal Way in Lake Forest. We handle cosmetic and structural repair, bumper and paint work, paintless dent removal, glass replacement, and vehicle diagnostics and calibration.
Our goal is simple: quality repairs, good service, and transparent pricing, with as little hassle as possible. We talk with your insurance provider, keep you posted while your car is with us, and stand behind our workmanship for as long as you own the vehicle.
We are open Monday through Friday. Call us, stop by, or send a message and we will get back to you as soon as we can.

## Services
- Cosmetic and structural repair: Bodywork for accident damage, from surface repairs to structural work, plus bumper and paint repair.
- Cost projection with no obligation: We look over the damage and give you a cost projection for repairs, with no obligation and no charge to get it.
- Insurance claims: We guide you through the claim, talk with your provider, and document repairs to your provider's guidelines.
- Paintless dent removal: Minor dents and dings taken out while keeping the original paint finish.
- Windshield and glass replacement: Damaged glass removed and new glass installed to manufacturer's standards for safety and visibility.
- Vehicle transport: If your car can't be driven, we can bring it to our shop for repairs.
- Interior and exterior cleaning: Cleaning, restoration, and finishing inside and out to keep your vehicle in good shape.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help the repair process go smoothly.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on the extent of the damage, the repairs needed, and parts availability. We send repair updates while your car is with us.

Q: Do you offer a warranty on your repairs?
A: Yes. Our workmanship is covered for as long as you own the vehicle, and parts carry the manufacturer's warranty. If something isn't right, bring the car back and we'll make it right.
